parts.title: Watching Is Fun. Playing Is BETTER! | Pet Buddy Quest #Shorts
parts.description:
Play along with Pip, Momo and Basil in Pet Buddy Quest: all 28 Primary 3 episodes, every line voiced. Beat the Buddies, shout "Hold on!" when you hear a mistake, and beat GLITCH, the robot who learns from your mistakes. Now in TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.

_note: Pet Buddy Quest: Primary 3 promo, 9:16 Short (29.9 s). The teacher's OK on 28 Nov 2026. Public, Made for Kids, Education. Goes at the end of 'TheOneApp Shorts', like TheOneApp Promo 1-3 #Shorts. No custom thumbnail (a Short shows a frame).
